title: Bow Valley Stand Up Paddleboarding and Surf

services.name: Lake SUP
services.desc: Never paddled before? Or maybe you’ve been curious about trying SUP but weren’t sure where to start? No problem-we’ve got you covered. With over 20 years of combined instruction experience, our guides will set you up for success from the very beginning.This course is the perfect introduction to stand-up paddleboarding. You’ll learn the essentials, from water safety and getting comfortable on your board to fundamental skills like maneuvering and turning with ease.Set against the stunning backdrop of cascade mountain-Johnson Lake in Banff National Park is the ideal location to progress your skills and you couldn’t ask for a better place to learn. services.desc: At Bow Valley SUP & Surf we offer inflatable kayak rentals for use across the area. All kayaks can be picked up deflated from our shop and transported to the lake of your choice. With easy pickup in Canmore for use in Banff National Park. Kayaks are very easy to inflate and usually take about 5 minutes maximum. Rentals come with: PFD (life jacket), pump, and paddle(s).
